subject: Alignment handshake: commitment ledger & proposed decision timeline
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Lowe <hannah@tempris.com>, Michael Brooks <michael.brooks@tempris.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Alignment handshake: commitment ledger & proposed decision timeline

Thanks again for the call earlier today — really helpful to walk through where Tempris is and what success looks like. Below is a succinct recap (pain, goals) and a proposed commitment ledger with dates and owners so we can all be aligned. I've attached a spreadsheet (commitment_ledger_v1.xlsx) and dropped a Drive link.

Key pain points you described:
- Real-time inference latency spikes during peak ingestion windows (~30–45% above target).
- Per-request cost on current vendor prohibitive for projected 10x scale.
- Auditability gap for model inputs/outputs — security and compliance team needs immutable logs and KMS integration.

Primary success criteria (30/60/90):
- 30 days: pilot ingesting 1k qps with median latency <150ms for targeted routes.
- 60 days: clear unit-cost reduction plan (target >30% savings) and KV/prefix caching trial on critical paths.
- 90 days: production readiness checklist met (logging, KMS, SLA alignment) and exec signoff to move to Dedicated capacity.

Proposed commitment ledger (owners & dates):
1) Pilot scope & dataset handoff — Owner: Michael Brooks (Tempris) — Due: 2026-10-27
2) Security questionnaire + evidence drop — Owner: Hannah Lowe (Tempris) — Due: 2026-10-29
3) Redwood pilot environment provisioned + perf baseline — Owner: Jasmine Liu (Redwood) — Due: 2026-11-03
4) Cost baseline & optimization recommendations (initial) — Owner: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — Due: 2026-11-10
5) Exec review & procurement readiness — Owner: Hannah Lowe (Tempris) / Redwood sales — Due: 2026-11-20

Decision process (as discussed):
- Technical PO + Infra lead run pilot acceptance (functional + perf).
- Security provides checklist signoff (SOC2 evidence / KMS confirmation).
- Procurement/Finance issues PO after exec sponsor confirms cost/term alignment.

Asks from Tempris for next week:
- Confirm the two internal approvers for procurement (name & email).
- Drop the security contact vCard (we'll add to our tracker).
- Share a representative sample dataset (anonymized) for the perf baseline.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I'll provision the pilot environment and share credentials + perf dashboard link by 2026-11-03.
- Karthik will run an initial cost analysis and suggest batching/quantization knobs by 2026-11-10.

Attachments: commitment_ledger_v1.xlsx (attached) — feel free to edit the owners/dates inline; I can update and redistribute.

Thanks again — if anything above looks off, call it out and I'll update.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
